name: email-testing
description: End-to-end testing of email-dependent flows — signup confirmation, password reset, magic-link login, OTP/MFA codes, and notification emails. Covers the capture-inbox decision tree (Mailpit, Mailosaur, MailSlurp, ShazaMail, Ethereal), Playwright polling without fixed sleeps, template-aware extraction of links/OTPs from the email body, deterministic per-test addresses (plus-addressing, per-inbox), subject/from/header/link assertions, SPF/DKIM/DMARC deliverability checks as a separate suite, and a lint of the captured HTML against documented Outlook/Gmail/Yahoo limits. Use when: "test the signup confirmation email," "password reset email test," "magic-link login test," "capture OTP from email," "Mailpit," "Mailosaur," "MailSlurp," "ShazaMail," "email arrives flaky in CI," "assert email subject/from/links," "email breaks in Outlook," "lint the email HTML." Not for: Sending transactional email from your app code, or API-only contract tests of an email provider — those are api-testing / app concerns. How an email actually renders in a client (Outlook/Gmail layout, dark mode) is out of scope: the lint flags documented limits only (note rendering as a gap; use seed accounts, Litmus or visual-testing). Related: playwright-automation, api-testing, test-data-management, qa-project-context.
